purpose: sha256 pins for the extended evidence mirrors used by the gems61 ribbon lane. The organizer's 19-band stack carries no radioelement channel and no 1 m lidar derivative (docs/IRREGULARITIES.md IR-58-DATA-01); these mirrors supply them on the study grid.
pins_source: sha256 values for the four external mirrors are copied from the 60GEMSDOE restore receipt (verified locally after restore); the DEM mirror pin was computed locally from the restored file and is labelled as such.

grid.note: identical to the organizer's sample_submission grid; the DEM mirror carries a 0.03 m x-origin offset (243349.965575182)

geodawn_rad_u8.tif.upstream: USGS GeoDAWN airborne radiometric release (public domain), as described on the competition about page (page 968) and the USGS GeoDAWN data release
geodawn_rad_u8.tif.usage: ordinal-only (8-bit reduced; physical scaling not published in this checkout)

geodawn_extensions_u8.tif.upstream: USGS GeoDAWN release: Th/K, U/K, U/Th ratios and a 150 m upward-continued TMI extension

lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif.upstream: scarp-morphology features derived from 706 of 716 USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM tiles covering the area (public domain)
lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif.usage: ordinal-only; the 'strike' band is a published orientation helper and is not used as a location channel

dem10_chi_100m_u8.tif.upstream: channel-network, knickpoint and raised-channel counts derived from the USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second DEM; per-tile sha256 pins in 60GEMSDOE data/external/dem10_chi_100m.manifest.json
dem10_chi_100m_u8.tif.pin_origin: computed locally from the restored mirror; the same file also appears in 60GEMSDOE data/restore_receipt.json

geodawn_dem_a2_100m.tif.upstream: GeoDAWN-area elevation reduced to the competition's 100 m grid (USGS product family)
geodawn_dem_a2_100m.tif.pin_origin: computed locally from the restored mirror copy (the pin is a transport pin, not an organizer signature)
geodawn_dem_a2_100m.tif.usage: raw physical units (float32, nodata -999999); used as a ridge channel through the same Hessian detector as every other layer

not_used_by_this_lane.gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv: USGS GDR 1391 well/spring locations (CC BY 4.0) - listed for completeness, not read by gems61
not_used_by_this_lane.gdr_qfaults_traces.csv: INGENIOUS quaternary fault traces (1,391 features) - catalogue-relative, therefore excluded from a catalogue-free emission
not_used_by_this_lane.derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8.tif: USGS SGMC quaternary structures rasterised at 100 m - catalogue-relative, excluded

limits: These are owner-published mirrors. Their hashes authenticate transport, not organizer provenance.
The 8-bit mirrors are used ordinal-only; no physical radioelement concentration is claimed or reported anywhere in this lane.
The competition allows additional data sources under the rules, provided the participant holds a licence permitting use and sharing with the sponsor; USGS products are public domain.
